description: Use this when the user wants Sitewalk to keep watching a website: check it regularly, re-audit it every week or month, or tell them when something breaks. Takes the site address and an optional frequency: weekly or monthly (default monthly). Sitewalk checks the site again on that schedule (the home page only, or up to 500 pages, depending on the account; the result says which) and emails the user when a serious problem is new or comes back, when one is fixed, when the health score drops, or when the site could not be checked. Asking again for the same site changes its frequency. The result says when the next check runs, or why the frequency is not available and which one is. Needs a signed-in Sitewalk account. Only use it for sites the user owns or is allowed to audit.
name: monitor_site
title: Monitor a site
